description: This file defines the 'ExtensionInterface' interface for the Twig templating engine, outlining methods that extension classes must implement to contribute token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators.

classes.name: ExtensionInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract that extension classes for Twig must adhere to, specifying methods for retrieving token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns token parser instances for extension.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns node visitor instances for extension.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns operators (unary and binary) to extend Twig, with detailed precedence and class information.
